name: Axis-Parallel Boxes
definition: For integers $n\ge2$ and $d\ge1$, let $X_n^d=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}^d$.  The class $\mathrm{BOX}_n^d$ consists of the indicator functions of all nonempty axis-parallel boxes $\prod_{j=1}^d[a_j,b_j]\cap X_n^d$, where $0\le a_j\le b_j<n$.  For $d=1$ these are the nonempty intervals of the ordered $n$-point domain.
comments: Goldman--Sloan use this finite box family for a whole-grid self-directed learning result. The catalogue self-directed parameter maximizes over subsets and equals $2d$ for $n>=3$. For asymptotic query comparisons, $d$ is fixed and $n$ tends to infinity.
